model_observation.scope: Actual omitted model overrides mean inherited session defaults; explicit experimental requests, where present, remain requests. The host does not expose authenticated resolved backend identities.

metrics.unavailable_reason: The session collaboration interface does not expose native per-thread token/billing/context telemetry. Values are not inferred from duration or tool counts.

limitations: Fresh execution replaces the unavailable earlier F attempt; earlier material remains separate. Instructional isolation on a shared host, capacity contention and unavailable resolved models/native usage limit causal claims. Live public source access failed TLS; frozen exact-source renders and textual retrieval are distinct. The source-selected persistent top-right toast temporarily covers header utilities until dismissed, a retained bounded-placement tradeoff. Actual screen-reader speech, natural-time smoothness, other engines and unrelated gallery destinations remain unverified.
